_comment: Expected agentic pass rate per smooth-operator engine. CI fails when an engine drops BELOW its baseline, and reports loudly when a known-broken one starts working (drop the exception, raise the baseline). Scenarios are chosen for distinct TOOL surfaces (read, search, edit, multi-file write, must-not-write) rather than difficulty — this gate catches an engine that stopped working, not a weak model. Measured 2026-08-08 with deepseek-v4-flash, host isolation.

ts.note: was 0% — the launcher booted a stale dist/ with no coding tools (th-11284c)
